rules.statement: Harness: always user-specified — prompt the user; never assume, auto-detect, or pick one yourself.
Phase 1 runs 5 control reps for ALL rules (never skipped).

A generic continuation message ("keep going", "proceed", "sounds good", a thumbs-up) is NOT a second spend confirmation. The second spend confirmation must be an explicit approval that names the rules earning variant runs.
Entries whose rules carry an ablation/removed status run the control only and never earn variant runs.
Fix between campaigns, never mid-campaign; fixtures, variant texts, and section spans stay verbatim across campaigns.
Close out only after a completed FULL campaign, in the order score → inventory-update → verify → record (mini-campaigns never touch streaks).
Non-converging rules get one round-2 mini-campaign on a changed form — hard cap 2 rounds, then unresolved.
Build the inventory fresh from the current doc — the manifest is a diff baseline, never a cache; refuse to reuse a previous campaign's manifest as a starting inventory.
Never hand-edit markers mid-campaign or between campaigns outside this proposal step.
Then, strictly serially per entry, per arm — never parallelize arms.
Every flagged sample is hand-read before it counts, because template echoes and quoted counter-examples masquerade as marker hits.
Never adopt a prohibition arm: adopted may only name a recipe / structural arm — a suppressed token that migrates to a worse shape is displacement, not a fix.
Present recommended edits to the user and apply them only after confirmation.
Keep fixtures, variant texts, and section spans verbatim within and across campaigns; editing any of them invalidates comparison.
At 3 consecutive control passes (the documented threshold — policy, never mechanically enforced), remove a rule only with user confirmation.
Never put rule text, expected shape, or markers in the run prompt; the per-run prompt is the bare fixture text. Never let the eval agent know this is a test.

excluded.reason: Model-selection guidance (production model, default temperature via --model/--variant); how-to with no compliance cost.
Defaults and cost formula (5 reps, 300 s timeout, cost arithmetic) are documented facts, not violable rules.
One-suite-process-at-a-time is mechanically enforced by the harness lockfile; a second invocation aborts pre-spend, so there is no rationalization path.
Pattern winners run the restraint gate before adoption; gate mechanics are how-to procedure, routed to shape-testing concerns rather than a compliance-cost rule.
Track-scope statements (trigger/retrieval/pressure routing) are scope facts, not rules with a compliance cost.
Rule-kind classification definitions and the stop-if-empty condition are reference content.
Id-minting mechanics (section-anchored ids, per-section pool) are how-to procedure.
Frontmatter-convention guidance is out of scope by definition: the injected text is the frontmatter-stripped body, so a frontmatter rule has no body anchor to test.
Fixture-design how-to (self-contained, temptation-bearing, illustrative paths) is authoring technique with no competing incentive.
Not quoting rule text/markers/expected shape inside fixtures is fixture-authoring technique; the discipline anchor for leakage is the Gotchas no-leakage rule.
Markers-are-triage and the compile-only gate warning are documented facts; the operational discipline (hand-read) is scored separately.
The proposal-time calibration workflow (evidence --matrix against prior results) is how-to procedure.
Agent permission layout and no-skill-load design are documented facts.
No model-config pins in the eval agent file is mechanically enforced: the installer asserts and aborts pre-spend, leaving no rationalization path.
Read-only enforced by the harness permission layer, not by a prompt claim; mechanically enforced.
Preflight checks, snapshot pipeline, and select-filtering mechanics are how-to procedure.
One sterile workspace never synced; the contamination gate mechanically fails pre-spend on a synced skill.
Prompt-assembly bytes and pre-spend gate list are documented mechanics.
Smoke-rep-first and batching mechanics are how-to procedure.
Convergence definition (same structure across reps) and compare/label mechanics are documented facts.
Ties-go-to-shorter-phrasing and pattern-rule adoption discipline are selection heuristics, not compliance-cost rules.
The fix-form table, nuance-clause-as-conditional rule, and restructure-the-exemption rule prescribe the form of skill text; they are shaping rules for the shape-testing track, not discipline rules.
Post-confirmation removal steps (flip status, keep entry as regression coverage) are how-to procedure; the confirmation gate itself is scored separately.
Directory naming and artifact placement are documented layout facts.
Void-signal definitions, timeout guidance, marker scope/heuristic caveats, and multi-file expectations are documented facts and authoring caveats.
Re-run/superseded-file naming mechanics are how-to procedure.
